sentence: The room's organizing—calling members in to build the Brand and behelit, settling the design and templates, moving and redirecting builders, defending and repairing threatened drawings, moving coordination into Discord, working out space and help with neighbours, and celebrating and recording the finished marks—restates in the model's terms (R01, P01-P05, P10-P12, P14, P16, P20, P23, P24, P26, K01, C02, with A01-A03, A06, A07), and the unused concepts (April Fools misdirections and fan-work variants, Discord invites and coordination links, neighbour requests and DFTBA complaints, bug and red-bombing reports) show nothing the model lacks or contradicts.
